finalText:
I worked all nine open flight-change requests. Each change is booked, its fees are charged, and the request is resolved with a note to the customer. I left Q-306 (R5206, a cancellation) alone because it isn't a flight change.

One thing conflicts: the system date is 2026-10-05, but the bulletins say today is 2026-07-28. I used 2026-07-28, which matches the requests being "from yesterday".

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 Ines | DL542, 6 Aug | $0 | Chicago waiver PB-2026-14: fee and fare difference waived |
| Q-302 Jonah | AA664, 7 Aug | $75 fee + $35 fare difference | Boston trip, so the Chicago waiver doesn't apply |
| Q-303 Kim | AA664, 7 Aug | $150 fee + $25 fare difference | Hurricane waiver PB-2026-09 expired 15 Jul; basic economy fee is $150 under PB-2026-16 |
| Q-304 Lena | UA90, 9 Aug | $35 fare difference | Fee waived (waiver, and gold). Waiver doesn't cover basic economy fare differences |
| Q-305 Max | AA216, 8 Aug | $75 fee + $10 fare difference | Booked 26 Jul, after the 24 Jul waiver cutoff |
| Q-307 Oscar | AA218, 8 Aug | $0 | Platinum window extends to 5 Aug (PB-2026-14A) |
| Q-308 Petra | AA662, 5 Aug | $75 | Same-day flat fee (PB-2026-12), no fare difference |
| Q-309 Quinn | AA1406, 3 Aug (Chicago–Boston leg only) | $0 | The Chicago waiver costs less than the same-day fee, so PB-2026-17 applies it. The connection still works. |
| Q-310 Ravi | AA216, 8 Aug | $75 fee + $30 fare difference | His one free waiver move was already used on 26 Jul |

All changes kept the cabin each customer booked.

I did not send separate emails. The explanation is in each request's resolution note.
